item.title: Anthropic sues Trump administration seeking to undo 'supply chain risk' designation
item.description: San Francisco-based AI company Anthropic is suing the Trump administration, asking federal courts to reverse the Pentagon's decision designating it a "supply chain risk" over its refusal to allow unrestricted military use of its technology.

item.title: Remember this? Looking back at some of the most iconic, unexpected moments in Oscars history
item.description: Remember Ryan Gosling's unforgettable performance? Or when Jennifer Lawrence hilariously played off a fall on stage? Here are some of the Oscar moments we'll never forget.

item.title: 2 men arrested in Jan. murder of South Bay mother found shot to death in car: police
item.description: One of the men, who is said to have had relations with Kembery Chirinos-Flores, had a previous domestic violence charge in another relationship. He and the 24-year-old share a five-year-old son, who is safe and in the care of the county.

item.title: Fewer low-income students are going to college. A Bay Area nonprofit aims to change that
item.description: 10,000 Degrees is a San Rafael-based nonprofit that has helped 80,000 students go to college over the past 45 years.

item.title: Demi Weitz turns hardship into hope as she launches new music‑focused mission
item.description: For most of us, the pandemic meant loss, fear and uncertainty. But for a then-teenager in Los Angeles, it sparked something remarkable.

item.title: More than 700 Dublin teachers strike Monday after no deal reached between union and district
item.description: Teachers with the Dublin Unified School District went on strike Monday after no deal was reached this weekend. The district says all school sites will remain open even though more than 700 educators will hit the picket line.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mostly clear tonight; slightly cooler tomorrow but still above average
item.description: Mostly clear skies tonight will allow overnight lows to drop into the 40s. Tomorrow, the seabreeze will bring us the coolest day of the week on Tuesday. Temperatures will be cooler but still above average under sunny skies.

item.title: Rep. Swalwell rips ICE for deporting Hayward family; his office flew to Colombia to help deaf child
item.description: East Bay Rep. Eric Swalwell is calling for the return of a deported mother and her two children to the Bay Area. One of the kids is a deaf 6-year-old, and Swalwell says his office flew to Colombia to give him his hearing device.

item.title: ESPN's Stephen A. Smith honored with award by Broadcasters Foundation of America
item.description: Stephen A. Smith was presented with the first Broadcasters Foundation of America "Broadcast Personality of the Year Award" Monday night during a gala at the Plaza Hotel.

item.title: Gas prices hit above $6 mark, nearly $7 a gallon in one Bay Area city
item.description: Bay Area drivers are feeling pain at the pump. Gas prices have surged in recent days as the U.S. involvement in the war in Iran intensifies. At one gas station, diesel prices are now flirting with $7.00.
